method: Verify every one of the 452 existing isolated Rust files against d5b893d37. Add the same four cofactor benchmark fixtures to baseline and candidate before timing: the certification module registration is retained as a patch, and the new module is retained verbatim. Build the baseline, preserve its executable, then overlay only curve_resultant.rs, its new lift_budget.rs test module, and work_budget.rs. Rebuild with unchanged compiler, profiles, workspace, and pruned lockfile. All 454 candidate Rust files match the root workspace; both executables pass all four new Criterion fixtures in test mode.
limitations: The pruned lockfile uses the same 215 package identities/checksums as the root but omits unused workspace edges. These source graphs are narrower than the full root workspace. Whole-executable size is neither library size nor allocation evidence.
